# Retire lifecycle

8 records support this lifecycle stage.

- [CDKTF](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cdktf) — Archived framework for defining Terraform infrastructure with general-purpose programming languages.
- [Grafana OnCall OSS](https://grafana.com/docs/oncall/latest/intro/) — Archived open-source on-call management and incident-response system whose active development continues in the commercial Grafana Cloud IRM service.
- [Kaniko](https://github.com/GoogleContainerTools/kaniko) — Build container images in Kubernetes without Docker daemon.
- [Keptn](https://keptn.sh) — Cloud-native lifecycle management and delivery.
- [Kubeapps](https://kubeapps.com) — Kubernetes application dashboard for deploying and managing Helm charts and other packages.
- [Kubernetes Dashboard](https://github.com/kubernetes-retired/dashboard) — Retired general-purpose web UI for Kubernetes clusters.
- [MinIO Community Server](https://github.com/minio/minio) — Archived and unmaintained AGPL-licensed S3-compatible object-storage server retained for historical and migration reference.
- [Talos Node Updater (tnu)](https://github.com/jfroy/tnu) — Archived Go utility that coordinated Talos Linux node upgrades through the Talos API and Rancher System Upgrade Controller.
